secrets.name: The Relief Order
secrets.hint: At the Barbican, something underfoot is not as it was laid.
secrets.found: Under the stone, wrapped in oilcloth: an order nobody carried the last hundred paces.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That one has been lifted before. Often, and carefully.

secrets.solution: Tap the pale, tilted flagstone to the right of the path at the Barbican.

secrets.name: What the Drum Counts
secrets.hint: The winch-house has more to say than it says at once.
secrets.found: The sealed drum ticks through a pattern, pauses, and begins again where it stopped three hundred years ago.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: Listen. Under the chain. It is counting, and it has not lost its place.

secrets.solution: Stand at the winch-house stop for fourteen seconds without choosing a way onward or taking anything.

secrets.name: The Second Candle
secrets.hint: The chapel alcove changes once the gate has no keeper.
secrets.found: A second candle stands beside the first. It is the same kind, and gives the same light without heat.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: I did not light that one. I want that understood.

secrets.solution: After the Ashen Sentinel has fallen, return to the chapel alcove and tap the new, cold-blue candle on the ground to the left.

secrets.name: A Charcoal Sketch
secrets.hint: Somebody left their working-out in the gate passage.
secrets.found: A square of hide, rolled tight and pushed into a crack: a charcoal drawing of a spring under a hanging tree.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: A drawing. Not of here. Keep it. Somebody wanted a place found again.

secrets.solution: Tap the rolled hide wedged between two stones on the left of the gate passage.

secrets.name: The Second Salute
secrets.hint: Good manners at the Barbican are noticed, and returned later.
secrets.found: He salutes, and this time it is not a formality. When it is over he sets his sword down hilt-first, toward you.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: He is saluting. He is waiting for you to finish resting. I think that is courtesy.

secrets.solution: Parry the very first blow the Banneret throws at the Barbican. At the chapel alcove later on that road a second duellist stands at the edge of the light: tap him and win.

secrets.name: Unmarked
secrets.hint: The Sentinel's discipline can be matched exactly.
secrets.found: Not a mark on you. The embers settle on your armour and go out.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: He never touched you. He stood a post for three hundred years and you gave him nothing to report.

secrets.solution: Defeat the Ashen Sentinel without being struck once.

secrets.name: The Lamplighter's Round
secrets.hint: On the Lantern Road, count what is lit and what is not.
secrets.found: The one dark lantern takes light from your hand and holds it. Inside the cage is a strip of bark, cut with marks.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It was only waiting to be asked. Everything here is still waiting to be asked.

secrets.solution: Tap the one unlit lantern standing low by the left of the Lantern Road.

secrets.name: The Shaded Stone
secrets.hint: A drawing found elsewhere shows this spring from the artist's side.
secrets.found: Under the middle stone, a tin of blacking and a rag: a soldier's kit, kept dry for three centuries.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: The middle one. Exactly as it was drawn. Somebody trusted a stranger to look closely.

secrets.solution: Holding the charcoal sketch from the Courtyard's gate passage, tap the row of three stones left of the spring under the gibbet tree.
secrets.locked_text: Three stones in a row by the water. They mean nothing to you yet.

secrets.name: The Last Row
secrets.hint: The deer trail keeps something for whoever walks it after the hunt is over.
secrets.found: A knife pins a strip of hide to the trunk. The last three rows have not been scored through. He left them for someone.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: He kept accounts. I approve of a man who keeps accounts, even of that.

secrets.solution: After the Pale Huntsman has been met and beaten, return to the fork at the deer trail and tap the knife standing in the stump on the right.

secrets.name: The Trimmed Posts
secrets.hint: Four marker posts stand about the woodpile. A lamplighter once wrote down how they are tended.
secrets.found: Each post warms under the hand in turn. At the fourth, all of them light, low and steady, along a road that was never cut.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: The fourth one lit. They were never markers. They are the lamps for a road nobody finished.

secrets.solution: Touch the four posts at the Woodpile in the order the Lamplighter's Round gives: tall, split, leaning, short.

secrets.name: What the Ravine Keeps
secrets.hint: The ravine answers those who are in no hurry to cross it.
secrets.found: From far below, a steady rush that is not water, and now and then a click, like a valve.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: Do you hear it? Water, where there is no river. They ran the cold lines under the forest. I signed for the pipe.

secrets.solution: With the Witness found, stand at the ravine stop for sixteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: Under the Drain
secrets.hint: In the nave, not every light comes from above.
secrets.found: Beneath the grate a lamp burns in a clean white corridor, and a stamped pipe runs along its wall.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: There is light under the floor. Churches do not keep their lamps under the floor.

secrets.solution: Tap the floor drain with light pulsing under it, right of the path in the nave.

secrets.name: End of the Cylinder
secrets.hint: The hymn in the choir loft is not as endless as it sounds.
secrets.found: The hymn runs out. In the silence a flat voice reads a batch number and a date, and the hymn begins again.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It stopped. And then it said a number. Hymns do not end with a number.

secrets.solution: Stand in the Choir Loft for sixteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: The Vent Cycle
secrets.hint: A few votive stands are set apart from the hundreds. Something beneath the nave explains them.
secrets.found: The stands dim one after another, and behind the candles a panel slides aside on a shelf of sealed tins of wax.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It opened. You lit candles in the right order and a wall opened. I am going to stop calling this a church.

secrets.solution: Touch the three votive stands in the order stamped on the pipe under the nave drain: the stand with two flames, then three, then one.

secrets.name: Six Cuts
secrets.hint: The Cathedral Steps keep a tally that only shows once nobody is standing guard over it.
secrets.found: Six short cuts in the oak, side by side, each made with two blades at once. Under them a seventh has been started and left.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: Six. She cut one for each of them, and kept the blade sharp enough to do it neatly. That is grief with a method.

secrets.solution: After the Crimson Widow has been faced, return to the Cathedral Steps and tap the blade standing in the fallen door-timber on the left.

secrets.name: Lamp Without Water
secrets.hint: The Drowned Stair is worth walking twice: once wet, once not.
secrets.found: With the water gone one lamp is left burning on bare stone. Its base is stamped with a row of small numbers.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It burned under the river the whole time. Take it out of the niche. Look at the base.

secrets.solution: Open the sluice, then walk the Drowned Stair again and tap the lamp left burning low on the right.

secrets.name: A Name You Answer To
secrets.hint: The reliquary lamp asks nothing. It does, given time, say something.
secrets.found: The lamp murmurs, too low to catch, and then quite clearly says a name. It is not yours. You answer to it anyway.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It said a name. You turned your head. You turned before I had finished hearing it.

secrets.solution: Sit by the reliquary lamp for eighteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: The First Winter
secrets.hint: The Weeping Tomb remembers a soldier you have already relieved.
secrets.found: He fights as he did before three hundred years wore him down to a post. Afterwards he looks at his hands, and is gone.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That is him. Before the ash. This is what they stored: the man from the first winter, when he still expected the thaw.

secrets.solution: Complete Lyra's task The Relief of the Gate, then return to the Weeping Tomb: a figure in unburnt garrison plate stands at the back. Tap him and win.

secrets.name: A Scratched Drawing
secrets.hint: One of the defaced kings was used as a slate.
secrets.found: Low on the plinth, where the chisel never reached, somebody scratched a picture of a great door and marked one point on it.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: A mason's mark, and a mason's secret. They always leave themselves a way back in.

secrets.solution: Tap the scratched plinth-stone on the right at the fourth stop of the Crypt (the Royal Vault and the Gallery of Kings).

secrets.name: One Who Stood
secrets.hint: The Glass Road ran once. Something in it did not.
secrets.found: A sword-point is fused upright into the glazed stone, and before it two footprints, set square.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: Somebody stood here while the road ran like water round their feet. And carried no shield. Look, there is none in the glass.

secrets.solution: Tap the blade fused upright into the road on the left of the Glass Road.

secrets.name: The Answer
secrets.hint: In the Mews a whistle went unanswered. Or so the falconer thought.
secrets.found: Long after the falconer's whistle has died, a sound comes down from the summit: one low note, patient, like a question.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: Something answered. From above the cloud. It has been waiting three hundred years for the second note.

secrets.solution: Stand in the Mews for sixteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: Imprint
secrets.hint: Something in the Boneyard knows its own.
secrets.found: The nest-stone warms under your hand, and something small and ember-bright rolls out from under it to your feet.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: It is warm because of what you are wearing. It thinks you are the keeper. Do not tell it otherwise.

secrets.solution: Wear the Broodmother's Ember (from the Clutch, or the wyrm) and tap the glowing nest-stone on the right of the Boneyard.
secrets.locked_text: A hollowed stone among the bones, faintly warm. It does nothing for you as you are.

secrets.name: Unshielded at the Summit
secrets.hint: Someone once faced the summit with less than you carry.
secrets.found: The sky is very large, and you met it with a blade and nothing else.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: As the one in the glass did. I shall record that it was done twice, and that the second walked down again.

secrets.solution: Defeat the Cinder Wyrm with no shield equipped.

secrets.name: Still Counting
secrets.hint: Of the Frozen Rank, more than one is breathing.
secrets.found: One of the rimed soldiers turns its head a finger's width toward you, and its breath shows, once.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: The third from the end. Its lips are moving. It is counting the watch. It thinks it is still the same night.

secrets.solution: Stand before the Frozen Rank for sixteen seconds without acting.

secrets.name: Twice Yourself
secrets.hint: On the Wall Walk somebody practised alone for an age. Ask what against.
secrets.found: It has your stance, your reach, and your habit of dropping the point. When it breaks, it breaks exactly the way you would.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That is a Recall surface. It is not showing you. It is playing you back.

secrets.solution: After beating the Rime Duelist, return to the Wall Walk and tap the slab of black ice standing on the left. Beat the reflection that steps out of it.

secrets.name: The Queen's Pane
secrets.hint: In the Solar everything is flowered with frost. Check that.
secrets.found: One pane is clear, and warm. On the sill beneath it lies a pot of pale grease, still soft.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: She kept one pane clear with her own hand, every morning, to watch the pass. I remember thinking it a waste of a queen's time.

secrets.solution: Tap the one clear, faintly lit pane propped on the right in the Solar.

secrets.name: Every Answer Exact
secrets.hint: The Winter King can be refused without a single flaw.
secrets.found: Not one parry early, not one late. The frost on the throne cracks along a single clean line.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: Every single one. You did not turn one blow early or late. He looked almost relieved.

secrets.solution: Defeat the Frostbound King with at least three parries, every one of them perfect.

secrets.name: The Seventh Plate
secrets.hint: Names have fallen from the Gallery wall. Somewhere above, they are still being read aloud.
secrets.found: The three plates settle, and behind the place they fell from, a seventh is set in the wall. It is blank but for a date.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: There were six who made you. This says seven. The seventh plate has no name on it. It has a date, and the date is the day you woke.

secrets.solution: Touch the three fallen plates in the order the Crypt's reliquary lamp reads its names: the long plate, the short plate, the struck plate.

secrets.name: Who Carried It
secrets.hint: The Last Candle was set down by someone. One of your companions could say who.
secrets.found: In the wax at the candle's foot is the print of a thumb, small, pressed in while it was warm.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: I know that hand. She carried it down herself, when she could still carry. Lyra, you were told you had never left the sanctuary.

secrets.solution: With the Witness found, tap the small cold candle on the left at the fourth stop of the Deep (Mark the Way and the Last Candle).

secrets.name: A Moment's Peace
secrets.hint: The Emptied Place has no treasure. It has something, for the patient.
secrets.found: You wait. Nothing comes. Nothing wants anything. After a while you notice you have been standing easy.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: Nothing happened. I checked twice. I think that may be the first time since you woke.

secrets.solution: Stand in the Emptied Place for twenty-two seconds without acting.

secrets.name: The Unfinished Statue
secrets.hint: On the Royal Mile every monarch's face was struck off. Count the monarchs, then the faces.
secrets.found: The last statue has no chisel marks. Its face was left smooth, waiting, and there is no name on the plinth.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: That one was never defaced. It was never carved. They left a plinth for whoever came next, and nobody did.

secrets.solution: Tap the small pale bust with a smooth, unbroken face on the right of the Royal Mile.

secrets.name: The Parade Sword of the Ninth Jubilee
secrets.hint: The Treasury was emptied by people with taste. They left one thing.
secrets.found: It is enormous, gilded, and enamelled with the faces of nine kings. It could not cut bread. Three hundred years of looters have walked past it.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: I was present when it was presented. The applause was the bravest thing I ever saw at court.

secrets.solution: Tap the gaudy gilt sword propped on the left in the Antechamber.

secrets.name: The Hinge Plate
secrets.hint: A mason who worked on the throne room left a drawing of it a long way from here.
secrets.found: The plate above the hinge gives under a flat hand. Behind it is the builders' own tally of who came through.

say.speaker: witness
say.text: The left door, above the low hinge. Press, do not pull. Masons. I told you.

secrets.solution: Holding the scratched drawing from the Crypt, tap the dull plate on the left at the throne room doors.
secrets.locked_text: A dull plate set low on a fallen door-leaf. It means nothing to you yet.

secrets.name: The Cycle Count
secrets.hint: The King's private door looks different to someone who has already seen how this ends, more than once.
secrets.found: A line of small cuts beside the door, at eye height, and a fresh one at the end. It is made with the edge you are carrying.

say.speaker: lyra
say.text: That mark was not there the first time. Or it was, and you could not see it yet. I do not know which frightens me more.

secrets.solution: See two different endings, begin a New Game Plus, and return to the King's Door in the Throne: tap the blade standing by it on the right.

hints.stops: A stretch of this road has not been walked on foot.
hints.guardians: Something here has not been faced.
hints.lore: A record on this road is unread.
hints.gear: Something made or carried here is not yet yours.
hints.missions: A task in the Journal is unfinished.
hints.mods_weapon: No blade has been taken as far as the forge can take it.
hints.mods_shield: No shield has been worked to its last tier.
hints.mods_armour: No piece of armour has been worked to its last tier.
hints.masteries: Some kind of weapon, shield or harness is still unfamiliar to your hands.
hints.combos: A sequence of the blade is unfound.
hints.endings: The Crown has been dealt with in fewer ways than there are.

t_second_candle.name: The Second Candle
t_second_candle.text: A light that came by itself after the gate lost its keeper.

t_clean_tabard.name: An Unmarked Tabard
t_clean_tabard.text: Worn against the Ashen Sentinel. Not a thread out of place.

t_trimmed_wick.name: A Trimmed Wick
t_trimmed_wick.text: From the lamps of a road nobody finished.

t_winter_token.name: First-Winter Token
t_winter_token.text: A garrison tally-disc, unburnt. One winter is stamped on it.

t_glass_footprints.name: Cast of Two Footprints
t_glass_footprints.text: Taken from the glazed road under the Roost.

t_split_frost.name: A Shard of the Winter Throne
t_split_frost.text: It broke along one clean line.

t_parade_sword.name: The Parade Sword of the Ninth Jubilee
t_parade_sword.text: Too ugly to steal. Hung where Orren does not have to look at it.

t_cycle_tally.name: A Rubbing of the Tally
t_cycle_tally.text: The marks by the King's door, in charcoal. All in one hand.

t_quarter.name: A Road Stone
t_quarter.text: From the first mile. Everyone starts with one.

t_half.name: A Half-Burned Map
t_half.text: Lyra's plan of the kingdom, with your corrections.

t_three_quarter.name: The Witness's Pen
t_three_quarter.text: He says he will not need it for a while.

t_complete.name: The Empty Plinth
t_complete.text: A plinth with no statue. There is nothing left to put on it that you have not seen.

t_courtyard.name: Winch Pawl
t_courtyard.text: The Fallen Courtyard, known stone by stone.

t_blackwood.name: Cold Lantern
t_blackwood.text: The Blackwood, known tree by tree.

t_cathedral.name: Hymn Cylinder
t_cathedral.text: The Cathedral of Ash, known to its drains.

t_crypt.name: Row Marker
t_crypt.text: The Sunken Crypt, known name by name.

t_roost.name: Keeper's Whistle
t_roost.text: The Wyrm's Roost, known to the summit.

t_citadel.name: Clear Pane
t_citadel.text: The Frozen Citadel, known in every room.

t_deep.name: Lead Box
t_deep.text: The Hollow Deep, known to the bottom.

t_throne.name: Mason's Nail
t_throne.text: The Hollow Throne, known behind its doors.
